notes.content:
[h1]0.4.12[/h1]

Greetings! More quality of life improvements. We continue to work on 1.0 content but want to improve the UI/Player experience for Early Access. We just got back from PAX East and are excited to continue work on 1.0. Thank you to everyone who stopped by the booth and said hi! Your support means the world to us.

[h2]UI[/h2]

[list]
[*] Weapon stats ui has been overhauled to give better insights into how weapons are being modified.
[*] Aim assist has been reworked and improved for controller.
[/list]

[h2]Runtimes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Runtimes can now be rejected at the time of pick up, similar to how augs work
[*] When Runtimes are maxed out, picking up another runtime will give a choice of three runtimes. Each runtime choice will replace a randomly acquired runtime.
[/list]

notes.content:
[h1]0.4.11[/h1]

Hello! We've been hard at work with 1.0 content, but wanted to stop by and give our EA release some love. Most of this is QoL updates which will help inform us if we are moving in the right direction with 1.0 content. We are expecting a few more EA updates, but internally we are on the final stretch of 1.0 development.

[h2]UI[/h2]

[list]
[*] Pausing the game now pauses the timer.
[*] Run stats view has been updated to include more stats.
[*] Doors now have collision boxes that force the player through the door.
[*] Weapons will now auto reload when empty, the player no longer has to force a reload.
[*] The pause menu and settings menus have been updated and refreshed.
[*] The underlying code around all menus has been updated. We hope this removes menu bugs that caused views to remain on screen.
[*] Two new experimental aim settings has been added:
[list]
[*]  auto aim
[*]  auto aim + auto fire
[/list]
[*] The current aim assist has also been reworked and is experimental.
[*] Added default mappings for dualshock controllers.
[*] Added default mappings for amazon fire tv remote.
[*] Added default mappings for ps4 rockband drumset.
[*] The tutorial has been updated to teach some more concepts to the player.
[*] The space dungeon will occasionally spawn a small room that requires the player to dash across to exit the room.
[/list]


[h2]Enemies and other NPCs[/h2]

[h3]Yellow Jacket[/h3]

[list]
[*] The YJ boss arena has been reworked to be more in line with the design of the other dock rooms. We hope this means that there is a little more room to dash around and avoid cyclones and bullets.
[*] Yellow Jacket cyclones now have 1hp and can be shot and destroyed.
[/list]

[h2]Runtimes[/h2]

[h3]Pay To Not Play[/h3]
[list]
[*] [i]For every 500 plu spent decrease boss health by 1%.[/i]
[*] Pay to Not Play added to the game.
[/list]

[h2]Calamities[/h2]

[h3]openfraine's Wealth Tax[/h3]
[list]
[*] [i]openfaine's careful manipulation of the plu economy forces every 150 of unspent plu to decrease damage done by Beary by 1%.[/i]
[*] openfraine's Wealth Tax added to the game.
[/list]

notes.content:
[h1]0.4.10[/h1]

Happy new year! In this update we are removing mid run saves. This means that rba will no longer save dungeon/galaxy location during a run; However, inspiration and proove tree progress will continued to be saved. The motivation for this change is to really simplify development and testing on our end. As a really small dev team, testing all the permutations that mid run saves produces is just too much effort for our team. Mid run saves also had a lot of bugs that required a lot of time and investigation to fix, and we honestly do not have time to improve the quality of mid run saves. Instead, that time is being spent on full release features, content, and other critical bug fixes.

We are adding new menus to view lifetime stats and mid run stats. View lifetime stats at the tv in the start room. Mid run stats can be viewed at the tv after beating galaxy masters.

[h2]UI[/h2]

[list]
[*] Holiday is CANCELED.
[*] Run progress is no longer saved mid run. Quitting or ending a run early will result in the next run being started at the beginning. Proove tree progress and inspiration collected are still saved.
[*] A dash indicator has been added to the hud to indicate when Beary's dash is off cooldown.
[*] A timer has been added to record run speed.
[/list]

[h2]Enemies and other NPCs[/h2]

[h3]Nicholas[/h3]

[list]
[*] boy bye.
[/list]

[h3]Battree[/h3]

[list]
[*] The Queen Returns.
[*] She no longer shields while spawning Battery Boi minions.
[/list]

[h2]Runtimes[/h2]

[h3]Scootin'[/h3]

[list]
[*] Dash cooldown increased from 20% to 50%
[/list]

[h2]Weapons, Items and Augs[/h2]

[list]
[*] All weapons cost more to purchase in the shop
[*] The inaccuracy debuff was increased for all "More Projectile" Augs.
[/list]

notes.title: Claws and Paws Fashion Update - 0.4.0
notes.content:
[h1]0.4.0[/h1]

[previewyoutube=l--xHO_3dO0;full][/previewyoutube]

We are excited about this new major update! We are implementing one of the most requested features for Beary Arms: Outfits! Currently a player can collect them during a run, but it will not save after leaving the game. In the future, players will be able to collect outfits and wear them for future runs. We would love to hear your ideas for different outfits for Beary. We plan on implementing more outfits as EA development progresses.

In this major update we reworked three major mechanics: dungeon crawl choice, weapon upgrades, and proove upgrade tree.

[h2]Dungeon Crawl Choice[/h2]

The Navigation screen has been removed. From feedback and our observation of players, we noticed that the nav screen was confusing and not being utilized to its full potential. The main intention of the nav screen was to give the player choice and provide another layer of strategy for the player to optimize. Instead, especially with new players, it seemed like it was information overload. We still want players to make a choice of where to travel to next and have an informed choice about rewards. Replacing the nav screen is a 3 option choice of what rewards the player would like to attempt to get in the next dungeon. After a certain amount of dungeon clears, the player will face off against the galaxy master.

[h2]Weapon Upgrades[/h2]

The old weapon upgrade system was another pain point for players. It also lacked player customization for runs. In this update we are introducing a new concept called Weapon Augmentations. Weapon Augmentations are iterative stackable “upgrades” for a specific weapon. This allows for more custom builds and experimentation with different weapons. Weapon rarity will determine how many augs and quality of augs a player can stack:

[list]
[*] Starter weapons: 2 aug slots, aug quality I
[*] Entry weapons: 3 aug slots, aug quality I
[*] Power weapons: 4 aug slots, aug quality I & II
[*] Super weapons 4-5 aug slots, aug quality II & III
[/list]

With this change, weapons collected no longer carry over after death.

[h2]Proove Upgrade Tree[/h2]

The last major change of this update is the proove tree has been moved and reworked. At the start of Beary’s run, the player will have access to a proove machine to spend inspiration in exchange for permanent upgrades. The tree itself is no longer randomized based on a given save file.

[h2]Thank You[/h2]

We are excited for you all to try the new changes and let us know what you all think!

[h2]UI[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Old Saves will be overwritten and will not work in this new update.[/b]
[*] 3 Beary outfits have been added. Pick them up after defeating a boss
[*] Removed the nav screen
[*] Added a new dungeon picker/reward screen when exiting dungeons
[*] Fixed visual glitch on certain dock rooms (Thanks nm41!)
[*] Made it more difficult for Beary to fall into water
[*] Items on the ground now have prompts to inform the player what is being picked up.
[*] Fixed a bug where bullets from certain enemies wouldn’t hit Beary’s hit box properly
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Beary Got Some New Toys (Patch Note 0.3.0)
notes.content:
[u][h1]Patch Notes 0.3.0[/h1][/u]
[b][h3]Furiends, Beary went shopping for some new toys at Pandora's Fox Toys & Games! This update introduces new weapons and weapon upgrades. We are also still attempting to balance the early game. Based on feedback we know there are some challenges with the early game of RBA. We really appreciate the community's feedback and involvement![/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42088450/ccb1f9917e21a73b982c5df938c7681965d863e4.png[/img]
[u][h2]Weapons, Items and Upgrades[/h2][/u]
[h3]Overall[/h3]
[list]
[*] Introduction of Primary and Secondary weapon upgrades. Primary upgrades largely improve weapon stats like, damage, fire rate, accuracy, and ammo capacity. Secondary weapon upgrades allow an effect to be applied to a weapon's bullet.
[*] Entry weapons reworked to be more likely to have 1 or 2 primary weapon upgrades.
[*] Entry weapons are most likely to have 0 or 1 secondary weapon upgrade.
[*] Power weapons reworked to be more likely to have 1 to 3 primary weapon upgrades.
[*] Power weapons are most likely to have 0 to 2 secondary weapon upgrades.
[*] Super weapons reworked to be more likely to have 2 to 3 primary weapon upgrades.
[*] Super weapons are most likely to have 0 to 3 secondary weapon upgrades.
[*] Health proove now increases weapon damage by 1 HP instead of 4%.
[/list]
[h3]A Salt Rifle[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added A salt Rifle to the game.
[*] [i]For self-preservation.[/i]
[*] A slower firing automatic rifle that deals decent damage.
[*] Entry Weapon Classification.
[/list]
[h3]Cannonloupe[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Cannonloupe to the game.
[*] [i]The folks from the lab designed explosive melons and a cannon to fire them from. What will they think of next?[/i]
[*] After a delayed trigger pull, the cannon releases an explosive melon to deal devastating damage to enemies.
[*] Super Weapon Classification.
[/list]
[h3]Mac 10 And Cheese[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Mac 10 And Cheese to the game.
[*] [i]The cheese powder is a radioactive yellow color.[/i]
[*] A fairly fast firing but weak submachine gun.
[*] Entry Weapon Classification.
[/list]
[h3]Glockamole[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Glockamole to the game.
[*] [i]Avocados, salt, lime juice, onion, cilantro, and bullets.[/i]
[*] A fast firing automatic pistol that doesn't hinder movement!
[*] Power Weapon Classification.
[/list]
[h3]Toaster[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Toaster to the game.
[*] [i]From Crazy Red's Kitchen Appliance Research and Development for the Department of Homeland Defense. And it makes toast.[/i]
[*] A low mag fast firing rifle.
[*] Super Weapon Classification.
[/list]
[h3]Chekhov's Gun[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Chekhov's Gun to the game.
[*] [i]Etched into the barrel, "The Bear".[/i]
[*] A low mag, slower firing, high damaging pistol.
[*] Super Weapon Classification.
[/list]
[h3]Instant Kill Secondary Upgrade[/h3]
[list]
[*] An instant kill upgrade is now possible for select weapons.
[*] Instant kill gives a weapon a slight chance to completely kill an enemy regardless of health Does not work on Galaxy Masters.
[*] Chances of Instant kill increase with each upgrade number.
[/list]
[h3]Freeze Secondary Upgrade[/h3]
[list]
[*] A Freeze upgrade is now possible for select weapons.
[*] Freeze gives a weapon a chance to freeze enemy movement.
[*] Chances of Freeze increase with each upgrade number.
[/list]
[h3]Successive Damage Secondary Upgrade[/h3]
[list]
[*] A Successive Damage upgrade is now possible for select weapons.
[*] Successive Damage allows a weapon to increase its damage incrementally with every hit shot on an enemy. The damage resets after a missed shot.
[/list]
[h3]Rail Gun[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increase ammo pickup from 10 to 25.
[/list]
[h3]Cap Gun[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased starting damage from 10 to 12.
[*] Increased magazine size from 3 to 4.
[*] Slightly decreased accuracy.
[/list]
[h3]Finger Gun[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased damage per bullet from 3 to 4.
[/list]
[h3]Hand Gun[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased starting damage from 5 to 6.
[*] Increased ammo capacity from 6 to 9.
[/list]
[h3]Alien Blaster[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced fire rate.
[*] Slightly decreased accuracy.
[*] Now an automatic weapon.
[*] Decreased ammo capacity from 12 to 6.
[*] Reduced reload time.
[/list]
[u][h2]Beary[/h2][/u]
[list]
[*] Starting health increased by a full heart.
[/list]
[u][h2]Nav[/h2][/u]
[h3]Overall[/h3]
[list]
[*] Radar Jam removed from dungeon rewards. If ya need jam, the shop can still spawn some.
[*] Reduced the starting Radar Jam required to face the first boss from 150 to 50.
[*] Radar Jam required to face subsequent galaxy master's increases by 50 per galaxy maxing out at 200.
[*] Crates are destroyed based on damage instead of number of hits.
[/list]
[u][h2]Enemies and other NPCs[/h2][/u]
[h3]Overall[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemies now drop [i]plu[/i] upon death instead of automatically depositing [i]plu[/i] into Beary's bank account.
[/list]
[h3]Mech Faction[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced health for all mobs.
[/list]
[u][h2]Misc[/h2][/u]
[list]
[*] Numerous bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: August State of Development
notes.content:
[b]FURiends![/b] We hope you are living your best lives out there.

What an incredible Early Access Launch! Thank you to everyone for your support! We want to keep the community looped into our development process, so we will share a monthly state of development for [i]Rightfully, Beary Arms[/i].

[h2]What we are currently working on:[/h2]

[h3]Load Times[/h3]

We are testing fixes for long load times on lower-end systems and Steam Decks. Initial load times at EA launch for the Steam Deck were up to two minutes. The fixes we are testing have reduced load times for the Steam Deck to just a couple of seconds.

[h3]Frame Drops[/h3]

There will be [i]some[/i] performance improvement to frame rate with the upcoming update. This will gradually improve over time as we optimize certain systems.

[h3]High Priority Bugs[/h3]

High priority bugs were reported and have been extrememly difficult for us to reproduce. We believe we have addressed a couple of these high priority bugs in the pending update.

[h3]Early Game Balance[/h3]

Player feedback and game statstics suggest a very punishing early game experience for Beary (sorry, buddy). Admittedly, this balance is difficult to approach. We brainstormed ideas to directly address this. However, we believe the learning curve reward factors into what makes roguelites/roguelikes uniquely enjoyable (get those dopamine hits!). We want to maintain some level of challenge while gently introducing new players to RBA's mechanics and gameplay. We expect the upcoming update will address the brutality of RBA's early game experience.

[h2]What we are looking forward to:[/h2]

A formal roadmap is difficult to verbalize at this time. We are prioritizing community and player feedback for our initial EA builds. For this reason, we want to avoid promising one feature or idea when the community is requesting something else. With that said, [b]we expect to expand some of the following elements in future updates:[/b]

[list]
[*] Weapons
[*] Enemies
[*] Bosses
[*] Calamities
[*] Runtimes
[*] Prooves
[/list]

Additionally, [b]we plan to take a deeper look at the "syenergies" around calamities-prooves-runtimes to craft more interesting and viabile builds[/b]. This is something that we expect to play with a lot during EA.

[b]Systems we want to approach at somepoint, but will not be seen in updates for the immediate future[/b]:

[list]
[*] Bestiary
[*] Player Statistics
[*] Narrative Elements (for 1.0 release)
[/list]
Stay tuned for further updates from us. [url=https://discord.gg/dKnEUmebkx]Join our Discord community[/url] or start a discussion on our Steam page! We would love to hear from you.

Stay PAWesome,
Daylight Basement Studio

notes.title: State Of Development - September 2022
notes.content:
[h1]THANK YOU <3[/h1]

It has been about 4 months since PAX East! A big thank you to everyone that attended our booth and played RBA. We received an incredible amount of feedback and we've been hard at work updating the game.

[h2]Changes[/h2]

Lots of changes, but I want to highlight some big changes to the player HUD. Previously, weapon and ability information was spread across different corners of the screen. We consolidated this information to the top right. Here, the player can easily view: weapon, ammo, and Proove cool downs. The mini map has been moved to the bottom right. Health and resource information has been collected and reworked to the top left. The symbols on either side of the screen signify modifiers (Runtimes or Calamities) applied to Beary or the world. And speaking of health... Health has been reworked to a heart system. Beary can lose a minimum of half a heart. Enemy health remains a continuous bar system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42088450/b35081a8060cbcb1ca73b0af13b2b3b2a65b7f6c.png[/img]

The map screen for the dungeon has been reworked as well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42088450/de577629c82c0878ee70ed0241a8d8b5c24eab7e.png[/img]

During playtesting, players sometimes lost themselves and enemies behind walls. Get lost no more! Beary and enemies are now highlighted when behind walls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42088450/27a025c66fe26b68962888f4a3d19e5de520142a.png[/img]

We added a reload indicator to Beary's crosshair. It will let players know when it is time to reload and when players are reloading.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42088450/06a3eedd6799369dd522dd26b37ea92ce5734284.png[/img]

The in-game inventory screen has been reworked to a weapon wheel that allows access to modifiers, weapons, and Prooves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42088450/4d333e466c6bb56814e168e3db1c0140ce717f9f.png[/img]

The final big UI change is the new modifier screen within the terminal. This new screen allows the player to view runtimes and calamities while navigating the galaxy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42088450/f193680b6ddca4655dd5dfce27c51227667d0de8.png[/img]

There are two new enemies: Peach Bum and Rocktapus.

Peach Bum is a common low level enemy belonging to the mech faction. It will follow the player and explode within a certain radius.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/vgA7kvp6WaKRnUcV9o/giphy.gif[/img]

Rocktapus is a low level Animal Boss. And he is here to rock out

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/OPC4in9P4To819FmEk/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[h2]What is Next?[/h2]

We will be attending [url=https://www.bostonfig.com/fest-homepage/]BostonFig[/url] virtually! RSVP and come check out our latest demo.

In terms of development, we are continuing to add content and organizing private internal playtests. The feedback from those playtests will determine the direction and the date that we move out of Alpha and into Beta. Stay tuned for more updates. Stay tuned for more updates. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/5RmvYfN]Discord[/url] if you want to chat more!

Rightfully,
Chris

[spoiler]Remember to stay hydrated![/spoiler]

notes.title: 1.0.0-Alpha
notes.content:
[h1]1.0.0-Alpha[/h1]

[h2]Navigation[/h2]

- Added galaxy screen. When finishing a boss, the player will have a choice in the next galaxy to visit.
- **Radar Jam** will hide Beary's spaceship from the boss of the current galaxy, once radar jam is depleted, the boss will find Beary and force a fight. Radar Jam is required for navigation.

[h2]UI[/h2]

- New off screen indicators
- New background objects when in a dungeon
- New intro art screen
- Added Xbox Controller support -- to continue using keyboard unplug the xbox controller
- Added game to Steam
- Added DRM to the build, it will only run if the user has the game in Steam

[h2]Weapons and Items[/h2]

[h3]Overall[/h3]

- Replaced cash with Plu
- Replaced Abilities with Pro͞ov
- Replaced Ability points with Inspiration
- Removed Fuel
- Added Radar Jam
- New ammo shell sprites
- added new props to levels which will drop plu if shot

[h3]Pixshooter[/h3]

- added Pixshooter: low damage, fast firing pistol. Free aim is disabled. Pixshooter can only aim the four cardinal directions

[h3]Catling Gun[/h3]

- Added Catling gun: high damaging, fast firing, inaccurate machine gun.

[h2]Enemies[/h2]

[h3]Overall[/h3]

- Improved pathfinding and level navigation
- Fixed enemy guns not able to target beary when beary was close to the enemy gun
- Enemies give less xp

[h3]Rabbit[/h3]
- reworked rabbit sprite

[h3]Yellow Jacket[/h3]
- added yellow jacket boss

[h3]Bull[/h3]
- Improved animations

[h3]Pandora's Fox[/h3]
- Added the shop keeper

[h3]Pigs[/h3]
- Added a pistol pig
- Added a shotgun pig
- Added a railgun pig

[h3]Bumble Bee[/h3]
- Added GlueGun Bumble
- Added Shotgun Bumble

[h3]Wasp Mom[/h3]
- Added Wasp Mom
